# Shebin T R

> AI Engineer, Agentic Systems Architect, and Distributed Backend Engineer specializing in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, High-Dimensional Vectorization & RAG Pipelines, Autonomous AI Agents, High-Throughput Microservices (FastAPI & Go), DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure, and Non-Custodial Multi-Chain Web3 Systems (BSC & TON).

## Summary

Shebin T R (handle: `ModelMschief`) is an Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Engineering specialist. His core technical strengths span:
- **Machine Learning & Deep Learning**: Custom CNN backbones, YOLO/object detection, dataset annotation pipelines, and PyTorch/OpenCV real-time visual inference.
- **High-Dimensional Vectorization & RAG**: Multi-modal embeddings, ChromaDB/Pinecone indexing, hybrid dense + BM25 sparse retrieval, and cross-encoder neural re-ranking (< 40ms P95 latency).
- **AI Agentic Systems**: Autonomous multi-step agent runtimes, dynamic tool sandboxing, long-term vector/episodic memory, and structured schema synthesis.
- **High-Throughput Distributed Backends**: Asynchronous microservices in Python (FastAPI/Flask), Go (Golang), and Node.js with Redis token-bucket rate limiting and sub-5ms caching.
- **DevOps, Cloud & Systems**: Docker containerization, Linux systemd daemonization, Google Cloud Platform (GCP Cloud Run), AWS, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
- **Multi-Chain Web3 & Cryptography**: Direct JSON-RPC node integration on Binance Smart Chain (BSC/EVM) and raw Bag-of-Cells (BOC) client bindings for The Open Network (TON/TVM) with zero third-party custody.

For a comprehensive technical dossier including architecture breakdowns, performance benchmarks, and implementation patterns, see [Full Technical Dossier (llms-full.txt)](https://shebin-tr.onrender.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Technical Disciplines

- [Deep Learning & Computer Vision](https://shebin-tr.onrender.com/llms-full.txt#deep-learning-and-computer-vision): Image classification, object detection (YOLO, custom CNNs), neural network architecture training, loss optimization, OpenCV visual processing pipelines.
- [Vectorization & Hybrid RAG](https://shebin-tr.onrender.com/llms-full.txt#vectorization-and-hybrid-rag): High-dimensional multi-modal vector embeddings, cosine distance partitioning, hybrid retrieval merging dense embeddings with BM25 sparse indices, cross-encoder re-ranking, and dynamic context compression.
- [Agentic AI Frameworks](https://shebin-tr.onrender.com/llms-full.txt#agentic-ai-frameworks): Multi-step autonomous agent OS (OrchestraAI), episodic and semantic memory architectures, sandboxed tool dispatching, schema-enforced LLM synthesis.
- [Distributed Backends & Microservices](https://shebin-tr.onrender.com/llms-full.txt#distributed-backends-and-microservices): Asynchronous Python (FastAPI, Flask, asyncio), Go (Golang concurrent goroutines and channels), Node.js/Express, Redis caching and pub/sub, WebSockets, and low-latency JSON-RPC.
- [DevOps, Cloud & SRE](https://shebin-tr.onrender.com/llms-full.txt#devops-cloud-and-sre): Docker multi-stage containerization, Linux system administration, systemd background daemons, GCP Cloud Run, AWS, Git/GitHub CI/CD, reverse proxies.
- [Multi-Chain Web3 & Cryptography](https://shebin-tr.onrender.com/llms-full.txt#multi-chain-web3-and-cryptography): Zero-custody payment infrastructure, EVM raw JSON-RPC on Binance Smart Chain, TON blockchain client libraries (TonLib, TonConnect, Cell BOC serialization), smart contract event polling.

## Key Projects

- [GateWays: Multi-Chain Non-Custodial Payment Gateway](https://github.com/ModelMschief/GateWays): Non-custodial multi-chain payment infrastructure supporting Binance Smart Chain (BSC) via direct JSON-RPC and The Open Network (TON) via TonLib. 100% private key sovereignty, zero third-party payment processors, and sub-second confirmation webhooks.
- [Custom Vectorization & Modular RAG Engine](https://github.com/ModelMschief/Mini-Project-Colab): Production-ready vectorization and Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework featuring hybrid dense + BM25 sparse search, reciprocal rank fusion, and cross-encoder neural re-ranking (< 40ms P95 retrieval latency).
- [Ton-Crypto-Lib: TON Blockchain Python SDK](https://github.com/ModelMschief/Ton-Crypto-Lib): Lightweight, async-first Python client library for TON (The Open Network). Implements pure-Python Bag-of-Cells (BOC) serialization, CRC32 checksumming, and TonConnect integration for Telegram Mini Apps.
- [OrchestraAI: Developer AI Agent OS](https://github.com/ModelMschief/OrchestraAI): Developer framework for multi-agent autonomous orchestration with persistent vector/episodic memory, automated tool registration and sandboxing, and unified multi-LLM routing.
- [reactbotfuse: Multi-Provider API Gateway Platform](https://github.com/ModelMschief/reactbotfuse): Distributed API gateway prototype hosting 5+ specialized microservices with image detection inference nodes, vector lookups, and Redis token bucket rate limiting. Live demo: [botfusion.kesug.com](https://botfusion.kesug.com/).
- [Premium: Telegram Payment & Automation Engine](https://github.com/ModelMschief/premium): Production automation daemon built on the Telegram Bot API handling high-concurrency webhook streams (< 60ms dispatch), Motor asynchronous MongoDB persistence, and automated subscription status synchronization.
